checkpoints.description: Establish independent repository scope and first Mandarin language profile.
Publish a language-independent typed ontology, JSON Schemas, source-grounded instance graph, and public ontology gallery in this repository.
Define independent semantics, identity, historical-phonetic-role, actual-sound, tone, and animation channels.
Record test specimens, research questions, experiment versioning, licensing policy.
Locate an authoritative public description of GF 0014-2009 and its limited 3,500-character scope.
Define an **experimental** shape-variant policy and a bounded 40-component pilot inventory.
Assign unique colors to **all 514 transcribed GF 0014 records** through a 510-key identity registry; preserve 3 extra pilot macros for 513 total colored identities.
Verify the transcription and the 30 descriptive forms against the official standard and obtain glyph geometry.
Verify each selected component and compound decomposition with an authoritative source and geometry.
Assign 40 unique exact colors to stable component IDs; preserve them in a 513-identity expanded catalog.
Produce machine-readable v0.1, v0.2, and v0.3 color catalogs, corresponding reference indices and swatch sheets.
Compute and document v0.3 with historic protected-40 constraint.
Correct that constraint: v0.4 freely reassigns all 513 identities without sacrificing global color separation.
Produce a Rust-based source-aligned component-colored compound SVG renderer; validate against pinned stroke-outline records.
Expand source-aligned coloring to nested/enclosing structures and single-component atomic glyphs (all 1,000 active first-tranche mappings; independent visual inspection remains pending).
Produce machine-readable source rejection diagnostics and side-by-side SVG/native-font review sheets, with non-certifying checks for component placement and perceptually close co-occurring colors.
Recover 73 additional mappings through source-owned subglyph decompositions, exact catalog identity and vector-geometry checks; retain source provenance and pending-review status.

Publish portable per-glyph source ownership records and isolated review images for 8 documented alternate decompositions and 27 partial unknown-source cases. Keep incomplete cases out of the active renderer.
Define a proposed three-arm component-color retention research scaffold with untested outcomes and outstanding visual, accessibility, ethics, and preregistration requirements.

Build a reproducible first-1,000-glyph independent-review worklist from final source-backed SVG ownership, sorting 26 OKLab proximity warnings in 25 glyphs without modifying colors or claiming certification.
Independently visually audit all 1,000 active stroke ownership mappings and adjudicate retained alternate/partial mapping research cases separately.
Compare plain, identity-only, and independently specified semantic-family variants.
Test legibility, distinctions at real glyph sizes, recall, and transfer.
Document failure cases and iterate with **new palette versions**.
Establish a reversible, source-pinned orthographic Pinyin citation baseline for all 1,171 first-tranche readings, without declaring phonemic or contextual verification.
Decode 1,392/1,393 pinned CC-CEDICT numbered Pinyin labels into the same orthographic tokens, preserving the exceptional r5 record and source capitalization.
Publish source-aligned citation-tone contour controls with five pinned example readings, leaving context-dependent neutral tone and all learning outcomes unresolved.
Source-link a working 21-consonant Pinyin initial-feature codebook and publish a Pinyin / provisional IPA / featural-shape comparison with 3 nonconsonantal spelling conventions kept separate.
Freeze the Mandarin phonological contrast inventory and a phonetic reference notation.
Compare Pinyin/IPA labels, initial-final symbols, and constructed featural glyphs.
Specify a decoding grammar and round-trip tests.
Test tone contours independently from segmental notation.
Try one integrated character-cell layout without changing the original strokes.
Screen 1,000 characters, recording provisional emoji and explicit deferrals.
Cross-reference 1,000 CC-CEDICT headwords and triage 897 expression hypotheses (248 whole-term mismatches).
Build source-first lexical and blind emoji-comprehension worksheets with local-only exports.
Add reading-specific provisional selections, unresolved statuses, and high-attention polysemy cohorts without promotion.
Extend source-first review to all 1,393 pinned reading records, including deferred pictograms, with local-only observations and validation.
Collect independent dictionary source locations and provisional contrasts for five first-priority characters (11 reading entries).
Compare five high-attention dictionary-gloss discrepancies against a third-source character dictionary, retaining an unresolved surname-tone conflict.
Build a 319-entry context-evidence acquisition queue with distinct source access, attribution, word-boundary, reading, and adjudication gates; no synthetic attestations.
Normalize the 319 high-attention source reading entries into 241 phonetic search groups without merging distinct lexical source records.

Acquire, version, and cross-check two independently selected Tatoeba sentence-ID candidate cohorts: 1,087 deduplicated character/sentence associations, 1,015 distinct source IDs, across 141/142 characters.
Record four additional dictionary research pages for the corpus-unmatched 刨 and preserve separate Mainland/Taiwan source qualifications.

Scan eight publisher-documented multi-character word leads against the pinned Tatoeba snapshot, retain 27 source-only candidate associations for six leads, and record 24 new distinct IDs (1,039 across all three source cohorts).
Publish searchable research-only character and word-candidate browser pages, while blocking unadjudicated pronunciations and senses from approval.
Preserve the 27 selected corpus word-source IDs with 20 public contributor usernames and pinned sentence-text fingerprints, without reproducing source sentences.

Check 27 of 27 selected Tatoeba word-sentence records against the live API: owner, content hash, written form and observed CC BY 2.0 FR license; preserve a dated audit without republishing sentence text.
Build a local-only, source-pinned sentence-context review intake and validator for the 27 selected word matches, with explicit nonapproval export rules.

Acquire and preserve dated ICU v78.3 tokenization triage for the 27 source-integrity-matching word examples (17 single-token, 4 multi-token, 6 crossing token boundaries), without calling tool output verified word segmentation.

Acquire a hashed official 125,310-entry CC-CEDICT snapshot and reconcile five exact word headwords against separately published Wiktionary Pinyin, leaving three unresolved and every sentence-reading approval at zero.
Independently check sentence-level reuse permissions, and record URLs before any corpus quotation or lexical promotion.
Independently adjudicate attested readings and usage-specific lexical senses, including higher-attention cases.
Conduct independently controlled blind emoji comprehension and accessibility evaluations.
Promote only after separately demonstrated lexical and pictogram acceptance. Currently approved: 0.
Put all channels into a dense but toggleable rendering.
Introduce segmented words, polyphones, sandhi, and contextual glosses.
Compare assisted learning, retention, and transfer to plain text.
Add reduced-motion semantic/articulatory animation trials.
